fieldNotes.operationalStatus: CLOSED / VACATED (high confidence on closure, low confidence on JSON layout fields). This is the Nestle Waters / BlueTriton ReadyRefresh distribution + light-manufacturing branch at 111 Thomas McGovern Dr, Jersey City NJ 07305 (APN 06-21507-0000-00001), a 3.4-acre / ~65,715 sqft warehouse Nestle had leased since 2008. Evidence of closure: (1) Yelp 'READYREFRESH - CLOSED' listing for 111 Thomas McGovern Dr (updated June 2026); (2) ~19,500 SF listed for sublease at the address (tenant offloading space); (3) Primo Brands has closed 49 facilities post-merger (Nov 2024) and is consolidating the ReadyRefresh delivery network. Satellite imagery (©2026 Airbus/Maxar/Vexcel) still shows the building intact, NOT demolished, with vehicles in the yard, but the imagery vintage likely predates the closure. Street View Oct-2025 and Apr-2026 shows the perimeter being used for third-party container storage (NYK shipping containers stacked along the W/NW fence) and overflow sleeper-tractor parking on the marshy E access road, consistent with the Nestle branch having wound down and the lot being partly repurposed/sublet. Building is standing and not demolished, so the property remains a usable yard asset, but YardFlow should treat this as a CLOSED Primo/BlueTriton site, not an active bottling plant.
